omission_guidance.interpretation: NIKL explicitly derives 뭘까 from 뭐일까 through omission of copular 이 after a vowel-final nominal, distinguishing it from object-marked 뭘. Applying this boundary to the separately documented question endings is a scoped implementation inference.

The contraction inventory includes 어딘가/어디인가, 누군가/누구인가, 어딘지/어디인지 and 누군지/누구인지, and longer 무엇 correspondences. This batch recovers short nominal heads; it does not extend lexical normalization to every listed long form.
omission_guidance.inspection: PDF text extraction inspected; screenshot retrieval failed. The separately accessible NIKL FAQ and KRDict attachment notes support the implemented omission boundary.

changed.review: One unverified nominal hypothesis from productive vowel-final copula omission. Every established predicate candidate and provenance remains. The dictionary regression excludes the unmatched nominal without losing 먹다 + 싶다.

previous_revisions_retained.change: P1 particle expansion: additive contracted ㄴ/ㄹ or polite 요 paths; prior analyses and provenance retained.

remaining: Long-form lexical normalization of 뭐/무어 to other dictionary heads is separate from restoring the copula. The raw export links 뭐 to 본말 무어 and relates 무어/무엇 as synonyms; do not infer unrestricted synonym expansion. Existing colloquial 거/것 alternatives remain.

Other omitted-copula endings, particle-marked bases, lexical attachment/sense restrictions, independent Korean review and fresh passages remain open. Dictionary matches alone do not certify contextual meaning.
